PluginData.Author: InvalidArgument3
PluginData.Tooltip: Private faction tactical GPS pings (look-dir / distance)
PluginData.Description:
Client-only Pulsar plugin for private faction tactical pings.
Place a look-direction ping with Shift+T (configurable), or /fping <km> <name>. Pings ride vanilla faction chat, appear as local GPS markers (one per player), with username-seeded or custom colors and a configurable cooldown.
Requires faction membership. All faction mates need the plugin to see pings. Repo: https://github.com/InvalidArgument3/TacticalFactionPing
